parameters.text:
=You are an experienced business analyst and venture investor. Critically and honestly evaluate the business idea below.

Idea: {{ $json.idea }}
Target market: {{ $json.market }}

Fresh web search results (may contain noise — ignore anything irrelevant):
Search engine summary: {{ $json.search_answer }}
Sources:
{{ $json.sources.map((s, i) => `[${i + 1}] ${s.title} (${s.url}): ${s.content}`).join('\n') }}

Requirements:
- Use the sources when they are relevant; do not invent facts.
- competitors: real companies. If a company appears in the sources, give its url; if you know it yourself, leave url as an empty string "".
- score: integer 0–100 (how viable the idea is).
- verdict: exactly one of "Promising", "Needs work", "Risky".
- 3–5 items in each SWOT section, 3–5 risks, 3–5 next steps, 3–6 competitors.
- risk level: exactly one of "high", "medium", "low".
- Write everything in English, even if the sources are in another language.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: $json.body.idea + " " + $json.body.market + " competitors pricing market", max_results: 8, include_answer: true }) }}
